# Baisa Home Stay & Party Hall

> Baisa Home Stay & Party Hall is a garden homestay and indoor party hall on Jaipur Ring Road in the Vatika-Beelwa area of south Jaipur, Rajasthan, about 10 minutes (6 km) from Chokhi Dhani. Six rooms (three air-conditioned, three non-AC) with work desks, a shared balcony, a garden and free parking, for short stays and long-term / monthly rental. Baisa Party Hall hosts birthdays, engagements and ring ceremonies, kitty parties, anniversaries and family functions. Rated 4.9 stars on Google. Website available in English and Hindi.

## Key facts
- Name: Baisa Home Stay & Party Hall (also written Baisa Homestay; Hindi: बाईसा होम स्टे एंड पार्टी हॉल)
- Address: ID/130, 14 Ring Road, near Vatika Road, Beelwa, Sukhdeopura Nohara, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302029, India
- Not affiliated with other homestays that have a similar name (for example in Vaishali Nagar): this property is on Jaipur Ring Road at Vatika-Beelwa, south Jaipur
- Location: Vatika-Beelwa, south Jaipur; about 6 km / 10 min from Chokhi Dhani; about 17 km from Jaipur International Airport; about 23 km from Jaipur Junction railway station (approximate road distances)
- WhatsApp and calls: +91 82094 30330; calls: +91 94604 91850
- Rooms: 6 rooms - 3 AC and 3 non-AC; every room has a work desk; shared balcony and garden; free on-site parking; self check-in with building staff
- Check-in after 2:00 PM; check-out before 10:00 AM
- Stay types: short stays and long-term / monthly rental; breakfast and extra mattresses on request
- Party hall: private indoor hall on the lower level; elegant stage and decor, comfortable banquet seating, parking; catering and decor assistance on request
- Rates: shared on request (message or call with dates and number of guests)
- Booking: homestay rooms on Airbnb; rooms and party hall on WhatsApp or phone (we usually reply within an hour)
